# Decision entry template

Copy into `docs/decisions/DECISION_LOG.md` (add an index row too). Keep the entry under ~200 words; link evidence instead of pasting it.

```markdown
### D-NNN

**<Title, one line>** — YYYY-MM-DD — accepted | proposed | superseded by D-MMM — decided by <owner | owner with ChatGPT review>.

**Decision.** What is now true. Imperative, testable.

**Context.** What forced the decision; link the baseline, experiment or PR that surfaced it.

**Consequences.** What changes in code, data, docs or process. What is now out of scope.

**Source.** Link to the primary record (owner note, PR, experiment).
```
